subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Fasting, Feasting’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anita Desai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fasting, Feasting **is a **novel **by Indian writer **Anita Desai**, first **published in 1999 **in Great **Britain **by **Chatto & Windus**. It was **shortlisted **for the **Booker Prize **for **fiction **in **1999**.
 
• **This novel **of **intricate family relations **plays out in **two countries**, **India **and the **United States**.
 
• The story **focuses **on the **life **of the **unmarried **and **main character**, **Uma**, **a spinster**, the **family's older daughter**, **with Arun**, the **boy **and **baby of the family**.
 
• The novel is in **two parts**. The **first part **is set in **India and **in part **two **the reader is **introduced to Arun in America**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Preeti Shenoy **has **written **many **books **some of them are **"Life is what you made it**" and "**Magic Mind**".
 
• **Anuja Chauhan **is an **Indian author**, **advertiser**, and **screenwriter**. As **a writer**, she is known for **The Zoya Factor**, **Battle For Bittora**.
 
• **Namita Gokhale **is an **Indian writer**, **editor**, **festival director**, and **publisher**. Her **debut novel**, **Paro: Dreams of Passion **was released in **1984.**
